title: Different properties in one action.
bodyText: All property necessary for any public use may be united in one action.
bodyHtml: §101-17  Different properties in one action.  All property necessary for any public use may be united in one action. [L 1896, c 45, §10; RL 1945, pt of §310; RL 1955, §8-15; HRS §101-17]
